name: Brenai (Wizra)
what: Companion game at brenai.fly.dev. The player talks with Wizra (22, college student, leans goth, plays D&D): 3D VRM body, voice, rooms, schedule, moods, memory, pictures, minigames, movie night, D&D night, and a relationship with five romance levels (0 to 4). Her words come from LM Studio on Andrew's PC (mn-violet-lotus-12b) through a websocket bridge; the server supplies everything around them. Full reference: brenai/MASTERFILE.md.
where: Live: https://brenai.fly.dev (deploys on push to main touching brenai/, workflow brenai-deploy.yml)
Data: Fly volume brenai_data at /data (3 GB): per-player saves, shared.json, avatar.vrm, anims.json, outfits/, pack/, inbox/
stack: Node 22, one server file (server.mjs, node:http, no framework, no build step); helpers persona.mjs, away.mjs, pics.mjs, movies.mjs, dnd.mjs
Brain: bridge/wizra-bridge.mjs on the PC, websocket out to the server (BRENAI_BRAIN_TOKEN); replyLocal() builds turns, systemBlocks() builds her instructions

Page: public/index.html plus avatar.js, avatar-vrm.js (three.js r0.187, @pixiv/three-vrm 3.5.5), places.js, mapkit.js, props.js, hang.js, minigame.js, dnd.js, robot.js, intro.js, facecam.js, sound.js, tongue.js, fineface.js, bodyfix.js, fitpip.js
Owner pages: dev.html (Studio) and mocap.html + mocap.js
Fly app brenai, volume /data (3 GB), deploys on push to main
When the Brenai Studio PC app is in Coding mode it swaps the model out and Wizra is offline

rules: Read brenai/MASTERFILE.md first (code wins if they disagree), then CODING.md
Run brenai/tools/check.sh and commit only if it passes, chained with &&; a new server file goes on the Dockerfile COPY line and into check.sh
Never put a // comment after code on a line that continues; use /* */
Do not read his chat with her or her notes about him; work with counts, timestamps and who spoke
Her model, outfits, motion clips and picture pack never go into git
Pushing to main deploys and restarts the server; do not deploy while a long job is using the live site
Never use em dashes. Answer short. Report only what was tested
avoid_redoing: Studio already covers character, rules, events, maps, layout and outfits: do not ask for code for those
Two players at once is parked on purpose
Sound is all Web Audio in sound.js, no audio files
